Admit four predeclared 2048-label zero-history artifact-only comparisons across both shifts and both registered fits. No new seed, setting, criterion or lineage. Keep 7200 CPU seconds of future operating/publication headroom inside discovery, separate from the protected confirmation reserve. The measured shortfall from one day remains explicit; remaining conditional designs are not exhausted and eighteen redundant acquisition descriptions remain excluded.
